title: Accuracy of half -guided implant placement with machine -driven or manual insertion: a prospective, randomized clinical study
authors: Orban K, Varga E Jr, Windisch P, Braunitzer G, Molnar B. Clin Oral Investig. 2022 Jan;26(1):1035-1043. doi: 10.1007/s00784-021-04087-0.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “No significant difference was found between the two groups in terms of accuracy and mean insertion torque, while machine-driven implant placement was significantly less time-consuming” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
